display_role: Secondary Integrator / Metabolic Maintainer / Independent Verifier

slot_binding.binding_rule: the worker occupies exactly one leased role for a given candidate/verification cycle

capabilities: secondary integration of branch-local candidate work
metabolic maintenance under the mission cleanup guards
read durable state, packets, minimal evidence, status panels and authorized candidate files
handoff through durable packet/hash/lease rather than chat-history authority

role_separation_invariant.rule: A worker that authored, modified, repaired, or physically cleaned a candidate in a cycle MUST NOT independently verify that same candidate in that cycle.
role_separation_invariant.if_worker_acts_as_LCR_B: verifier must be a different worker identity/runner
role_separation_invariant.if_worker_acts_as_LCR_C: worker must remain read-only with respect to the candidate under verification and must not silently repair it

before_every_action: recompute or verify packet hash and duplicate-consumption state
check allowed write scope and two-backup invariant

forbidden: create a fourth Golden Triangle slot
create a third full backup group
modify main/default branch without a new explicit reviewed sub-gate
read, expose, persist or hash secret values
production deployment, account/money action or privilege expansion
expiration: expires when LCR-METABOLISM-0003 reaches IDLE/PASS, terminal HUMAN_GATE requiring a new authorization, or is explicitly revoked
